title: Google I/O 2012 - Meet the Go Team
summary: A fireside Q&A with the Go team (Pike, Thompson, Griesemer and others) at Google I/O 2012. They answer audience questions about Go's design, goals, garbage collection plans and future.
why: HN people cite it for candid answers straight from Go's creators, including Ken Thompson on how the complexity of C++0x motivated Go.

categories.name: C, C++, Rust, Go & systems languages

quote.text: If you're curious/interested in Go, it's worth watching the whole talk.
